about: V00 voiceover script for ElevenLabs. Female tutor voice, warm and clear, unhurried. Each line is generated as its own clip and placed at film time t (seconds). say = what is spoken when it differs from text.

lines.text: At first, markets look like noise. This course teaches you to read them, step by step.
Hi, I'm your XORA tutor! Welcome to Futures Edge.
Twenty-three short lessons, five phases, and no experience needed. Pause and replay any time.
Never traded before? Not sure what BTC or USDT means? That's completely fine.
lines.say: Never traded before? Not sure what B T C, or U S D T means? That's completely fine.

lines.text: Every new word is explained before we use it.
Each lesson works in five ways.
Watch a short animation.
Read simple notes.
Flip through short slides.
Try it yourself, with fictional prices.
Then take a quick quiz. Every answer is explained.
Here's the path we'll walk together.
First, crypto foundations: what crypto is, and why prices move.
Then trading basics: long and short, orders, profit, loss and fees.
Next, how futures work, with margin, leverage and liquidation.
Then reading charts: candlesticks, trends and key levels.
And finally, scalping and risk management.
Three short checkpoints show you what to review.
Before we start: this course is for learning and demo practice only.
There's no live trading, and no real money.
We will never ask for your passwords, OTP codes or API keys.
lines.say: We will never ask for your passwords, O T P codes, or A P I keys.

lines.text: And every price you see is fictional.
Practise first. Real money is never needed here.
Futures can lose money quickly.
Leverage makes losses bigger, not just gains.
Fees can turn a small win into a loss.
And signals can be wrong.
So you always have three choices: buy, sell, or wait.
If you're not sure, waiting is a decision too.
By the end, you should be able to:
read the BTC USDT pair,
lines.say: read the B T C, U S D T pair,

lines.text: read a candlestick chart,
tell spot from futures,
explain why leverage is risky,
and know when not to trade.
One lesson at a time.
Up next: lesson one. What is cryptocurrency? See you there!
